messages:
marta: seeing an LCP regression on /dashboard EU canary after the telemetry-proxy rollout. heatmap + sparklines slower in traces, main-thread parse spike. replay: https://replay.internal/def456 :grimacing:
kevin: flame shows large parse from a new chunk + massive KV cache misses. metrics pane chunk size increased ~90KB gzipped
sam: reproduced locally. new import `viz-serializer` is executed during nav because it's imported at module top, so parse happens on navigation
olivia: I added that serializer for CSV export, kept it sync to avoid complexity. didn't realize prefetch would cause eager parse on nav
marta: telemetry also shows a kvcache-prefix miss surge around the same time. we added metric-id namespace last week; could be schema mismatch causing rehydration of big objects
kevin: fix plan: 1) make serializer dynamic-imported so it only parses when needed; 2) gate prefetch with device/visible-charts heuristic; 3) mark prefetch requests with X-Purpose: prefetch so infra can exclude them from quota math
sam: I'll open a small PR with conditional prefetch code and telemetry hooks for `prefetch.requested` and `kvcache.lookup.variant` so we can confirm root cause
olivia: PR https://github.com/redwood/viz/pull/456  includes dynamic import, chunkName, and a trimmed csv-only serializer build. fallback remains for legacy browsers
marta: can we rollback the telemetry-proxy canary while we stabilize? @deploy-bot roll back canary-proxy to previous sha please
deploy-bot: rollback request received from marta 1 initiating rollback of canary-proxy -> sha abc123. est ~2m :hourglass_flowing_sand:
kevin: after rollback median LCP on EU canary drops ~350ms. let's run a 10% EU canary with Olivia's changes and gate for 48h. add alert if median LCP > baseline +200ms and watch kvcache miss rate
sam: noted, will add the canary manifest change and alert to the PR
olivia: adding a CI parse-time test for the trimmed serializer so we catch regressions early
marta: follow-ups/tickets: telemetry key migration doc (sam), infra quota-exclusion for prefetch (kevin), small-serializer release + CI (olivia). I'll file them after this thread
deploy-bot: rollback complete for canary-proxy -> sha abc123. monitoring
